Bot.title: Discord Bot
Bot.description: Information about a Discord bot added by a user.

token.description: The Discord bot token (encrypted or server-side only ideally, but stored for bot functionality).

ownerUid.description: Firebase UID of the user who added the bot.

botId.description: The Discord user ID of the bot.

Panel.title: Ticket Panel
Panel.description: Configuration for a ticket panel in a specific Discord server.

botId.description: ID of the bot managing this panel.

guildId.description: Discord Guild ID where the panel is located.

channelId.description: Discord Channel ID where the panel message is sent.

imageUrl.description: Optional image URL for the embed.

ownerUid.description: Firebase UID of the panel creator.

Ticket.title: Active Ticket
Ticket.description: Information about an open ticket channel.

creatorId.description: Discord ID of the user who opened the ticket.

/bots/{botId}.description: Collection of bots added to the system.
